metadata.description: Axiom — a local-first Rust runtime for online Test-Time Training, context compression, grounding, and self-healing execution.

plugins.name: axiom
plugins.description: Adds the Axiom MCP tools: compress a repository into a dense context fingerprint and expand symbols back on demand, store and recall durable project memory, verify claims against evidence, score code for architectural drift, report learned self-healing immunity, and coordinate multi-agent work through a task board. Requires the `axiom` binary on PATH (see repository README for install).
